status: R21 circuit candidate; JLC exact catalogue identity found, stock not reserved
recommendation: 500 kΩ linear rheostat in the same capless F-shaft mechanical family as the existing pots. Keep its local RC node and buffer on the pot PCB.
caveat: Not user-approved final electrical value. JLC snapshot showed zero stock/minimum 10; procure through approved pre-order/external route. Pot resistance ±20%; exact pad/terminal convention and CW-slower wiring require audit. No resize of body or shaft.

quantity: 10: five parallel 100 nF capacitors per channel
status: R21 candidate; JLC description reviewed; primary capacitor specification not retained
recommendation: Nominal 0.50 µF C0G per cell, separate from the LF398 hold capacitor. Low-absorption finite-band lag prototype.
caveat: JLC describes 100 nF/50 V/C0G/±5%/1206. Electrical limits and insulation resistance require exact manufacturer evidence before selection. Never substitute X7R silently. Five placements per bank; no claim this is cheapest final implementation.

status: LCSC identity verified; JLC assembly listing not verified
recommendation: First-prototype recommendation: one dedicated S&H IC per channel, with local hold capacitor and protected trigger pulse.
caveat: SOIC-14, not SOIC-8. It tracks while SAMPLE is asserted: provide a short pulse for edge sampling. Acquisition time, offset, hold step and droop require tests with the actual capacitor. No precision-pitch or long-hold guarantee. Rev C §6.6 gives up to 200 pA hold leakage at TJ=25 C: with 10 nF this alone is 20 mV/s. Precision pitch/long-hold behavior is NOT established. Test 10 nF and 100 nF candidates with appropriately increased acquisition time.

role: One-shot for both S&H trigger inputs
status: Exact part visible in JLC monostable category; order review pending
recommendation: Dual non-retriggerable one-shot: clean rising edge → bounded acquisition pulse. Set unused pins and reset explicitly.
caveat: Use conditioned logic-level inputs, not raw modular voltages. Pulse width must exceed worst-case acquisition/settling; 50–100 us is a test range, not a qualified setting. Triggers during a busy pulse are intentionally not new samples.

role: Trigger conditioning and optional clip detectors
quantity: 1 for two trigger comparators; more for other detectors
status: JLC exact catalogue entry verified
recommendation: Dual comparator with designed hysteresis and a 5 V pull-up domain for trigger conditioning.
caveat: Comparator output is open collector. Choose divider/clamp/threshold and protect unpowered conditions. This is not direct ±12 V-to-logic wiring.

status: JLC exact catalogue entry verified
recommendation: 10 nF, 50 V, C0G, ±5%, 0805. Start with this part in the acquisition/droop test.
caveat: A larger hold capacitor can reduce leakage-related droop but needs longer acquisition. Low absorption and PCB cleanliness matter more than tight nominal capacitance tolerance. Do not use X7R as an unexplained replacement.

role: Six MULT outputs plus two S&H post-buffers
quantity: 3 quad packages proposed for six MULT buffer slots and four SLEW buffer slots; partition review pending
status: JLC entry verified; retrieved page offered pre-order / no allocated stock
recommendation: Two quads reserve the six MULT buffers; a third quad provides two pre-lag and two post-lag buffers on the local SLEW board.
caveat: This count excludes input conditioners and A/B buffers. An output isolation resistor outside feedback can introduce load-dependent pitch error. Stability, protection, calibration and signal headroom need qualification. Do not double-count R20 S&H post-buffers: the post-lag pair replaces that role. Some slots remain spare; quantity is not a full-instrument order BOM.

status: Manufacturer identity verified; no JLC code assigned
recommendation: Low-leakage analogue-switch alternative if LF398 procurement is unsuitable.
caveat: Needs separate input/output amplifiers and local hold capacitors. Charge injection, source impedance, settling and switch timing must be designed. Not a drop-in replacement for LF398.

role: Two-position selectors, including new A/B pair
status: Previously user-selected; JLC identity rechecked
recommendation: Keep 5 RANGE + 6 SHAPE + 6 STAGE, and add 2 manual A/B controls.
caveat: A/B signal path should isolate its two source inputs with designed buffers/resistors. The exact contact transition must be verified; do not promise clickless switching or assume source-short protection from the word ON–ON.

status: Selected design intent; external procurement
recommendation: Retain matching T1-lever counterpart. No functional change from R17.
caveat: Factory sourcing/consignment still needs acceptance. Nut, pivot, actual throw, panel engagement and support datum remain unqualified.

role: Six TRIG + two manual SAMPLE buttons
status: Candidate; JLC exact catalogue entry verified
recommendation: Compare this 6×6 mm tactile switch with a guided panel plunger on a near-panel board.
caveat: 5 mm catalogue height is not an approved exposed button height. The drawing uses a 5 mm circle as the finger target; cap/plunger, mounting plane and stroke are still open.

quantity: 99 original continuous-control positions (values/tapers pending); excludes two new B504 SLEW pots
status: Existing mechanical reference; manufacturer drawing rechecked
recommendation: Keep the nominal Ø6 mm capless F-shaft. B103 is the 10 kΩ linear starting value.
caveat: Each circuit still needs its own value/taper decision. Body width, side lugs and 20 mm shaft-length datum are not a 6 mm footprint or a PCB-to-tip measurement. The viewer reserves 12×12 mm, not a qualified courtyard.

status: Existing selected direction; manufacturer specification rechecked
recommendation: Six positions; retain actual 16.2×18.5×7.5 mm body envelope. The proposed 17 mm column grid leaves 0.8 mm body gap.
caveat: Actuator/cap and full panel mounting stack remain open. Do not confuse 15 mm actuator L datum with installed PCB-to-panel spacing. The 8 mm visible actuator in this study remains an unselected cap envelope.

status: Carry-forward candidate, not new stock verification
recommendation: Use one mechanically qualified jack lot with black IN and red OUT dress nuts.
caveat: 8.3 mm nut envelope is a trial assumption. Exact EARS nut OD/thread, jack shoulder, panel thickness, engagement, pin assignment and plug clearance remain open. JLC record does not prove normal-stock availability.

status: Carry-forward sample recommendation
recommendation: Use low-current visual evaluation with buffered detector/driver; never attach to the hold capacitor or envelope timing node.
caveat: White bin, optical path, lightpipe/diffuser and package-height arrangement remain unqualified. The 1.32 mm drawn aperture is not an exact part. No OSC lamps.

role: Clip indicators at four SUM and six OFFSET outputs
status: Carry-forward sample recommendation
recommendation: Independent red CLIP detectors; pre-VCA mixer clipping must also be visible.
caveat: Illustrative ±10 V demo threshold is not circuit headroom. Set real thresholds from output swing, load and supply limits.

role: General mixers / filters / folders / A/B support
status: Carry-forward analogue candidate
recommendation: Low-cost general buffer, summing and shaping amplifier. A/B planning uses two input buffers and an output buffer per cell.
caveat: Do not assign a quantity from empty rectangles. Input range, headroom, grounding and exact analogue circuit remain design work. Precision pitch paths use a separate error budget.

role: MIX4 gain cells and three filter/VCA blocks
status: Carry-forward analogue candidate
recommendation: Dual OTA building block; use external input scaling, current control and output buffering.
caveat: One OTA is not a complete synth VCA. Offset, feedthrough, resonance, loading and noise need circuit tests.

status: Carry-forward external candidate; not requalified in this pass
recommendation: Build and calibrate one complete oscillator before replicating five. Separate sine shaping required.
caveat: Exact current manufacturer datasheet, negative-supply arrangement and component lot need qualification. No through-zero FM claim; SOIC-16 version is intended. This is not a completed oscillator circuit.

role: Four noise outputs, shared source basis
status: Carry-forward external programmed-component candidate
recommendation: White/pink outputs plus proposed band-limited analogue shaping for blue/brown; each output buffered.
caveat: Pseudo-random digital source internally. Programmed part required. Four outputs need not be statistically independent. No internal S&H normal connection.

mpn: Exact keyed header + socket / terminated harness set
quantity: Derived from circuit boundary, not jack count
status: Not selected
recommendation: Use supported, factory-populated mating pairs. Keep S&H storage and oscillator timing nodes local.
caveat: No socket-body height is a PCB-to-PCB stack guarantee. Define signals, ground returns, mating retention and each board plane before routing.

mpn: Existing zudo-pd Board P + Board B
status: User project reuse; not a new electrical design
recommendation: Retain separate power assembly and model a reserved pocket, not a taller full-width core stack.
caveat: The latest depth study is only a target. Need current populated power model, regulator heat, service access, true return paths and verified 15 V-only configuration for the exact board revision.
